advisory.finding: The drift gate's failing path is never tested: no test drives find_drift() or main() against a genuinely under-declared model, so main's exit-1 / DRIFT-report branch (the whole purpose of the CI gate) is exercised nowhere. Only the green exit-0 path (main(["--check"])==0) and find_drift()=={} on the clean tree are asserted.
merged_from: The durable drift gate only detects MISSING property declarations, not requiredness drift, so the AC2 class of defect this diff fixes (VerifySignatureResultOut marking schema-required fields optional) is guarded only by a single static per-model assertion — a requiredness regression on any other mirrored model (WorkflowRunOut, GroundingInfoOut, SignResultOut) would be caught by neither the gate nor any test.
scenarios: A future edit makes main() return 0 (or raise) when drift is present — the gate silently stops gating and CI stays green
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a test that monkeypatches MODEL_SCHEMAS/PERMISSIVE_OMISSIONS (or injects a model whose fields omit a schema property) so find_drift() returns a non-empty dict and main(["--check"]) returns 1, and capture stderr to assert the 'DRIFT:' report is emitted.
